name: Exp_NonLagDot
summary: This EA trades trend reversals signaled by the NonLagDot custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator shifts from downtrend (2) to uptrend (1) and sell positions on the opposite transition. It includes configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggle switches for opening and closing long/short positions. The EA operates on new bar detection to avoid excessive tick-level trading.
summary_zh: 该EA基于NonLagDot自定义指标的趋势反转信号进行交易，当指标从下行趋势(2)转为上行趋势(1)时开多仓，反之开空仓。它包含可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈以及独立的买卖开平仓开关。EA通过新K线检测机制避免逐tick过度交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于NonLagDot指标的趋势跟踪反转交易。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值从2变为1时触发做多信号（趋势从下行转上行），同时可选择平空仓；当指标值从1变为2时触发做空信号（趋势从上行转下行），同时可选择平多仓。出场条件分为两种：一是反向信号触发时的对冲平仓，二是独立的止损止盈机制（默认止损1000点，止盈2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后自由保证金、基于亏损后余额的比例计算。资金管理通过MarginMode枚举实现灵活的仓位计算，默认使用固定手数0.1手。EA还设计了新K线检测机制，仅在出现新K线或需要重新计算时才执行信号判断，有效减少冗余计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend-following reversal trading based on the NonLagDot indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator buffer value changes from 2 to 1 (trend shifting from down to up), with an option to simultaneously close sell positions; a sell signal is triggered when the value changes from 1 to 2 (trend shifting from up to down), with an option to simultaneously close buy positions. Exit conditions are twofold: counter-signal exits where an opposing signal closes existing positions, and fixed stop loss/take profit exits (default SL 1000 points, TP 2000 points). Position sizing supports five margin modes: fixed lot, free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, and loss-adjusted balance. Money management is implemented via the MarginMode enum for flexible lot calculation, defaulting to a fixed 0.1 lot. The EA also implements a new bar detection mechanism, executing signal logic only on new bars or when recalculation is needed, effectively reducing redundant computations on every tick.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size, meaning per MMMode

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/按余额/按自由保证金等）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on reverse signal

pros: 新K线检测机制避免逐tick重复计算，减少资源消耗和虚假信号
买卖开平仓独立开关设计灵活，可单独控制每个方向的交易行为
支持五种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好的交易者
指标参数可配置，允许优化调整以适应不同市场环境
使用CopyBuffer获取指标值并有失败重算机制（Recount），增强鲁棒性
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism avoids per-tick redundant computation, reducing resource usage and false signals
Independent toggle switches for buy/sell open/close provide flexible control over each trading direction
Five money management modes accommodate traders with different risk preferences
Configurable indicator parameters allow optimization for different market conditions
CopyBuffer failure triggers recalculation via Recount flag, improving robustness
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，在多数品种上可能导致巨额亏损风险
缺乏点差过滤和波动率过滤，在低流动性时段容易被滑点和虚假信号伤害
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在同方向已持仓时重复开仓
依赖iCustom调用外部指标'NonLagDot'，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行且错误信息不明确
SignalBar=1时使用前一根K线信号，可能产生滞后；设为0时使用当前未完成K线，可能产生反复信号
cons_en: Default SL 1000 and TP 2000 points are excessively wide, posing significant loss risk on most instruments
No spread filter or volatility filter, making the EA vulnerable to slippage and false signals during low-liquidity sessions
No existing position check before opening new trades, potentially leading to duplicate positions in the same direction
Depends on iCustom call to external 'NonLagDot' indicator; if the file is missing the EA fails with a vague error message
SignalBar=1 uses the previous bar which may lag; SignalBar=0 uses the incomplete current bar which may generate repeated signals
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓和过度杠杆
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在低流动性时段交易
将止损止盈默认值调整为更合理的范围，并增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈选项
improvements_en: Add position existence check before opening new trades to prevent duplicate positions and over-leveraging
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during low-liquidity periods
Adjust default SL/TP to more reasonable ranges and add ATR-based dynamic SL/TP option

risk_points: 默认止损1000点过大，单笔亏损可能超过账户承受能力
缺乏持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓造成过度敞口
无点差过滤在高点差时段可能以不利价格成交
risk_points_en: Default 1000-point SL is very wide, single-trade loss could exceed account tolerance
Lack of position check may cause duplicate same-direction positions leading to overexposure
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills during high-spread periods
